title: Super Typhoon Rosal to bring rains over parts of Luzon, Eastern Visayas
summary: Super Typhoon Rosal may bring rains over parts of Northern and Southern Luzon and Eastern Visayas on Wednesday as it continues to move closer to Northern Luzon, according to PAGASA.
